⑨ Verify, then wait for CI
Finds the PR by marker; refuses if the plan file still says
ready (unverified). Polls the combined commit status
until every check has registered and resolved.
run log: verified / unverified, ci-waiting, ci-resolved
CI red → a CI-fix session (check names only today; 0069
adds the stored log). CI green → dispatch-review.py: a
Fable session posts the verdict; MEDIUM/LOW → issue.
forge: review, review-ledger comment, follow-ups issue
HIGH → a fix session on the same branch, push, back
to ⑩. Bound exhausted, or nothing pushed → stop.
forge: commits; run log: review-round, review-stopped
Pushes refused while an approval stands. Polls the PR

Two approvals; the operator merges in Minos. The steward sees
release_lease; the worktree is kept for the record; the job
exits and fleet-watch reaps its launchd label next cycle.
`respawn` as a top-level comment on the PR (bound to
FLEET_OPERATOR_UID); or a fix by hand; or nothing.
Reads leases and fleet.db, classifies the stop reason
(CLASS_RULES) and composes a brief with a shortlist
that fits THIS failure and a Minos deep link.
A lease whose heartbeat lapsed or whose process is gone
is orphaned. Paged ONCE per lease; never respawned
without a human's `respawn` comment newer than the lease.
respawn → a fresh dispatch of the same plan, at the cap
